newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end stable on upcoming payments.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end stable on upcoming payments.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed stable on Thursday as the market expected liquidity to tighten on Friday's payment deadline for T$50 billion worth of government bonds, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.011 percent against Wednesday's 5.009 close, with 30-day commercial paper staying unchanged at 5.05-5.10 percent. Dealers expected the bond payments to boost the rates slightly on Friday.
The bond market did not see transaction in the afternoon. The 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1375 against 6.1275 after morning trade. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
